title: Record ADRs: storage and key custody, threat model, profile authority
description: Spec §15 asks for short decisions before implementation. These are also the design questions opum-agent records in opum-doc (vault format, keychain binding, plugin name); the ADRs here are this repo's position to argue there.

acceptanceCriteria.text: Lore ADRs exist for vault format/key custody, the P0 threat model and non-guarantees, and profile approval authority
